title: Like-for-Like Carpet Cost Limits by Floor Plan: Security Deposit Account
content:
The carpet cost basis of a Security Deposit Account carpet replacement charge is held to a like-for-like cost for the floor plan on the Apartment Home Lease:

| Floor plan on the lease | Carpet cost basis |
|---|---|
| Studio Residence | the recorded replacement cost, at most 1050.00 USD |
| One-Bedroom Residence | the recorded replacement cost, at most 1050.00 USD |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | the recorded replacement cost, at most 1250.00 USD |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | the recorded replacement cost, at most 1250.00 USD |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | the recorded replacement cost |
| Penthouse Residence | the recorded replacement cost |

**Records read.** The floor plan of the Apartment Home Lease, and the replacement cost recorded on the carpet replacement line.

## Hypothetical cases

| Floor plan | Recorded replacement cost | Cost basis |
|---|---|---|
| One-Bedroom Residence | 1400.00 | 1050.00 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 980.00 | 980.00 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 1250.00 | 1250.00 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 1600.00 | 1250.00 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 1900.00 | 1900.00 |
